subject: Request: elevated POC credits + extended evaluation window for OmniFin
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.k@omnifin.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: larger POC credits and extended trial window for evaluation

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile but we still need to validate sustained throughput and cost for a production inference pipeline. We have a tight engineering window and a live internal demo scheduled for 2027-06-01 that depends on a fully instrumented POC.

To get meaningful results we need two things beyond your standard PLG trial:
- A larger one-time credit pool (we estimate ~150k tokens) to run parallel workloads across our staging clusters.
- An extended evaluation window (120 days) so our infra and security teams can complete load and compliance tests.

We also need an SSO-enabled test tenant and a copy of your most recent SOC2 / data handling summary for security.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can make an exception here? This is a strategic procurement for us — if the POC goes well we expect to convert to a reserved deployment and ~1.2M ARR within 12 months.

Best,
Sara Kline
Head of Platform Engineering
OmniFin

Attachments: OmniFin_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: deal-desk@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: larger POC credits and extended trial window for evaluation

Forwarding OmniFin request — customer is asking for a one-time uplift (150k tokens) + 120-day extension and SSO test tenant. They have a June 1 internal demo and note potential ARR ~1.2M if we win production.

Quick context: OmniFin is a mid-market fintech prospect we’ve been engaging since January (intro via conference). Deal stage: POC kickoff. Standard PLG limits are 30k tokens / 30 days. This request is significantly above those thresholds.

Recommended starting point for discussion: grant a one-time 100k credit and a 90-day extension, tied to an addendum and security checklist completion. If leadership prefers a larger uplift, please advise. Demo is next Wednesday, so we need a decision this week.

I’ve attached their security overview they sent.

Attachments: OmniFin_security_overview.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: OmniFin one-off POC uplift (details + recommended terms)

Jordan / team —

As discussed, OmniFin is requesting 150k tokens + 120 days. Key facts:
- Opportunity: platform evaluation for low-latency trading infra, potential ARR ~1.2M within 12 months if successful.
- Timeline: customer demo on 2027-06-01; they need SSO and SOC2 evidence to satisfy procurement/security.
- Current PLG limits: 30k / 30d.

Deal desk recommendation: approve a one-time 100k token credit + 90-day extension. Conditions: signed addendum (trial addendum with usage limits), SSO test tenant provisioned, security checklist closed. Finance should tag credits as promotional one-off and legal to prepare addendum.

Upside / rationale: this is a high-velocity POC with strong conversion signal; the uplift is one-off and can be instrumented to force a commercial decision (i.e., after 90d we move to paid reserved or sunset access).

If approved, I’ll coordinate DocuSign and add the tracking metadata (deal DF-6123). Requesting signoff today to meet the customer timeline.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-04T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: OmniFin one-off POC uplift (details + recommended terms)

Aditya / Kimberly —

I reviewed the ask and the customer context. Approved with modifications:
- Approve one-time 100,000 token credits (promotional).
- Approve a 90-day evaluation extension (from the PLG baseline).

Conditions:
1) Legal to prepare a short trial addendum (no change to pricing; credits expire after 90 days).
2) Security checklist (SSO + SOC2 evidence) must be completed and documented prior to provisioning SSO.
3) Customer must agree to POC success criteria (basic throughput targets and a short adoption milestone) that will be attached to the addendum.
4) Finance to classify these credits as a one-off promotional uplift (track in internal credits ledger under code DF-6123).

Please proceed — Aditya, coordinate DocuSign and capture the HubSpot notes. Kimberly, confirm you’ll send the addendum and next steps to Sara.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
